resources.string: Only watches Instagram and YouTube, only to detect when Reels or Shorts are opened, then covers them. Other apps are never seen. The app has no internet access, so nothing can be collected or sent anywhere.
You turned on Reel Blocker to stay off short videos. The Reel was closed. Press Back to return to the app, or Home to leave.

Android will warn that this app gets \"full control\". It shows that warning for every accessibility app. Reel Blocker only looks at Instagram and YouTube, and it has no internet access, so nothing can leave your phone.
